findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1, so every existing `wait_exponential_jitter` user now has a one-second floor on the wait time. Before, the floor was 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, max=0.5)` or any config whose computed wait is below 1s. The return at line 273 is `max(max(0, self.min), ...)`, so the result is clamped up to 1s. If `max` is below 1, the floor even exceeds the configured maximum. Users see longer waits than before and than their configured `max`, which is a silent behavior change.
